column1: # Paraphrases the Common Paper (commonpaper.com) and Bonterms (bonterms.com) standard agreements, both CC BY 4.0. Changes: summarized, compared and the not_an_issue_by_default column added by Manigent Contributors (2026-10-11); Common Paper CSA 3.0 differences added 2026-10-11. Bonterms Cloud Terms and DPA v2.0 re-read 2026-10-11.

column2: Multiple of fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim; 1x is the most common choice (CSA 2.1 cover page)
column3: General Cap = amounts paid or payable in the 12 months before the first incident (Cloud Terms v1.0 s.16.1, 16.5)

column2: Increased Cap for Increased Claims (pre-selected: privacy/security and confidentiality breaches); must not be 1x; used in ~13% of CSAs. CSA 3.0: no Increased Claims in the standard text; a super-cap must be written on the Cover Page (s.8.1)
column3: Enhanced Cap = 3x the General Cap, for Provider's breach of s.5.2 (Security) or either party's breach of s.5.3 (DPA)
column5: CP CSA 2.1 cover-page guide; CSA 3.0 s.8.1

column2: Indemnity pre-selected as Unlimited Claim (~1% of CSAs use further Unlimited Claims). CSA 3.0: no Unlimited Claims; gross negligence, willful misconduct and fraud uncapped (s.8.4); no Covered Claims defined means no indemnity (s.9.1(c))
column3: Uncapped Claims: indemnity obligations; infringement/misappropriation of the other party's IP; confidentiality breach excluding Customer Data (those go to Enhanced Cap); liability that cannot be limited by law
column4: confidentiality breaches involving Customer Data sitting under the super-cap rather than uncapped

column3: Not a default (handled by the Enhanced Cap)

column2: Auto-renews unless notice by the Non-Renewal Notice Date; 30 days chosen in ~84% of auto-renewing CSAs
column3: 12-month initial term; auto-renews unless notice >= 30 days before term end; no price-increase mechanism in the standard text (s.14.1)
Export during the term; delete within 60 days of request (s.14.4)

column2: Consent needed except merger/reorganisation/sale of substantially all assets or voting securities, on notice (s.12.6); runs both ways
column3: Same M&A exception for either party (s.22.1)
column4: an M&A exception that runs to both parties

column2: 10 business days; 30 days to object; silence = acceptance (DPA 1.1 s.2.6)
column3: At least 30 days before the new sub-processor processes data (DPA v2 s.4.3); 30 days to object on reasonable data-protection grounds; if unresolved, terminate the affected part with refund of prepaid unused fees as sole remedy (s.4.4)
column4: notice via list update plus email; termination of the affected service as the objection remedy

column3: Within the Specified Notice Period = 48 hours (DPA v2 s.5.2(b)(i), s.1.28)
column4: any fixed deadline from 24 to 72 hours, or 'without undue delay' plus a 72-hour outer limit (GDPR Art. 33 sets 72h only for controller-to-regulator)

column2: Information, third-party report summary, annual questionnaire; records kept 3 years after DPA ends (s.5)
column3: Audit reports first; on-site audit only if reports are insufficient, a regulator requires it, or after an incident; no more than once annually (s.9.2, 9.3(c)(iv))
column4: reports-first audit with once-a-year on-site right

column2: Public, known before, third-party, independently developed
column3: Same; independent development must be documented
column4: independent-development exclusion without a documentation requirement; no 'competing products' clause (Bonterms NDA s.8 expressly allows the recipient to build competing products absent breach)
n/a - a residuals clause is never standard

column2: On expiry or request; certify on request; backup copies allowed but remain protected
